title: Covid Tracker
oneLiner: Full-stack tracker for patient and facility data—React UI, Node services, and Auth0-gated access during the pandemic spike.

problem.heading: Problem
problem.description: Early COVID tooling needed fast iteration: trusted identities for staff, simple data entry under stress, and views that leadership could read without SQL. Spreadsheets were not audit-friendly enough for shared hospital or clinic use.

myRole.heading: My role
myRole.description: Owned authentication flows with Auth0, built React dashboards for intake and status rollups, and wired Node endpoints for persistence with basic validation and access checks aligned to roles.

solution.heading: Solution
solution.description: Covid Tracker paired a guarded SPA with APIs that enforced tenant-style separation where possible, prioritized forms that minimized clicks, and logged critical mutations so coordinators could trace changes.

impact.heading: Impact
metrics: 🔐 Auth0-backed roles instead of home-grown password risk
⏱️ End-to-end delivery under urgent pandemic timelines
📂 GitHub repo as the living architecture reference
impact.description: A time-capsule project that still shows how I integrate identity providers and ship under pressure.
